objectives.title: Organization, representative authority, and tenancy baseline
objectives.statement: Integrated master-development-plan objective consolidating the frozen Volumes 0-10 baseline for organization, representative authority, and tenancy baseline. Documentary plan only; authorizes no implementation, provisioning, procurement, staffing, test execution, release, or deployment.
objectives.objective: Consolidate the organization, representative-authority, jurisdiction, and tenancy planning baseline for the club-affiliation vertical.
objectives.institutional_outcome: Governed, tenant-aware institutional identity is the precondition for every affiliation determination.
